title: Red/Black Sabo
summary: A red/black deck built on one trick: several cards gain +12 cost while on the table. Once you control a cost 12+ Character, your cheap Straw Hats all get much stronger.
gamePlan: Find and play Jaguar.D.Saul (4 cost, counts as 16) or Loki (6 cost, counts as 18). Saul also digs for more {Elbaph} cards.
With a cost 12+ Character out, the 2-cost Straw Hats (Zoro, Usopp, Sanji, Nico Robin) get +3000 power, and Monkey.D.Luffy (OP17-093) gains [Rush].
Your Leader: give it 1 DON!! and, with a cost 8+ Character on your side, your Leader and every Character get +1000. Downside: with 4 or more Life the Leader has −1000 power.
Loki's [On Play] K.O.s your opponent's Characters with a total cost of 4 or less, and Loki gets +3000 power on your opponent's turn.

keyCards.why: Leader. +1000 to your whole team once you have a cost 8+ Character.
4 cost that counts as cost 16, and finds more Elbaph cards.
Counts as cost 18, clears small Characters, and is tough on defense.
Gains [Rush] and replays a cheap Character from your trash.
7000 power that counts as cost 11 and brings back a Straw Hat from your trash.

howItWins: Switch on the cost-12 bonus early, then swarm with cheap Straw Hats that hit as hard as 5-cost Characters.
weakTo: Removal aimed at Saul and Loki. Without a cost 12+ Character your small Characters are just 2000 power.
Early pressure while your Leader is at 4000 power (4+ Life).
mulliganTips: Hunt for Jaguar.D.Saul or Loki. Keep hands with one of them or a searcher like Usopp (OP17-080).
